captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a replacement keyboard folding leg. It features a wide, flat rectangular foot with rounded front corners and a recessed center on the underside to save material. The hinge end includes two cylindrical pivot pins extending outwards, supported by larger cylindrical collars and small rectangular reinforcement tabs underneath.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric replacement keyboard leg with adjustable length, depth, thickness, and corner radius. The model should include customizable cylindrical pivot pins on both sides, supported by larger hinge cylinders and small supporting tabs underneath.
captions.factory: The script constructs the keyboard leg using a main flat cube and two cylinders for the hinge assembly, combined in a union. Corner rounding is achieved by subtracting custom hollowed corner shapes (cylinders subtracted from cubes) from the front corners. Two rectangular slot cutouts are subtracted near the hinges to allow clearance, and a large shallow pocket is subtracted from the bottom face. Finally, two small support cubes are unioned at the outer edges below the pivot pins.
